entity.description:
The is a (TCG) released by and licensed by . First announced on March 7, 2022, the card game released in Japan in July 2022 as part of One Piece's 25th anniversary celebrations. It released worldwide later in 2022. As of 2026, it is one of the most popular trading card games in the world.

Cards feature full-color illustrations. Each card has different attributes and point values. It is quite similar to Magic: The Gathering, and shares several rules and mechanics with other Bandai trading card games, including the Dragon Ball Super Card Game.

A card's artwork generally originates from one of four sources: the manga (and novel A), the anime, a new illustration for the card, or "other". Thus far, "other" has included:

Starter Decks are packs of cards generally intended to include a full, playable set. Each Starter Deck includes 17 variations of cards, with one, two, or four of each card, depending on its rarity; in total, each Starter Deck includes 61 cards. The cards in Starter Decks are usually unique to that deck, with only alternate art versions of the cards releasing elsewhere.
